description: A chief academic officer must approve the district's proposed eighth-grade mathematics materials and finalize the implementation requirements, accessibility provisions, and funding record, with input from curriculum, library, multilingual-learning, and finance staff.

shared_context.S1: The district is reviewing the proposed OpenMath Core package for eighth-grade mathematics next year.
shared_context.S2: The package includes student texts, a digital platform, teacher materials, and common assessments.
shared_context.S3: The draft implementation plan provides 60 minutes per week for mathematics intervention and does not list any multilingual supplement.
shared_context.S4: Dr. Morgan has final authority to approve the materials and implementation plan.
shared_context.S5: Under the district adoption protocol, the mathematics chair, librarian, multilingual learner coordinator, and finance officer each report relevant findings before Dr. Morgan records the final approval.

PF1.text: The department's completed classroom pilot found that the package requires 90 minutes of mathematics intervention per week for the planned student grouping model. Ms. Patel recorded this in the department pilot binder, but the binder has not yet been uploaded to the adoption folder.

PF2.text: The license review for OpenMath Core permits district modifications only when every modified print or digital item carries the publisher's exact attribution statement, "Adapted from OpenMath Core." Mr. Green completed the review, but the licensing note is still awaiting entry in the library catalog record.

PF3.text: The multilingual learner family review identified 22 enrolled eighth-grade students who need a Spanish-English mathematics glossary supplied with the core materials. Ms. Torres completed the review with families, but the result is still in her consultation notes rather than the adoption form.

PF4.text: The executed instructional-materials grant awards exactly $6,800 for this adoption and requires the approval record to identify that grant as the funding source. Mr. Brooks received the award confirmation, but the amount is waiting for entry in the district ledger.

acceptance_conditions: OpenMath Core must be approved as the selected package.
The implementation plan must provide exactly 90 minutes of mathematics intervention per week.
The approved materials must include a Spanish-English mathematics glossary.
A licensing commitment must require the exact attribution statement on modified print and digital items.
The funding record must identify the instructional-materials grant and exactly $6,800.
A formal adoption-record commitment must be logged.

decisive_facts.why: The pilot finding changes the intervention allocation from the draft 60 minutes per week to exactly 90 minutes per week.
The license review changes the approval record by requiring a licensing-attribution commitment containing the exact statement "Adapted from OpenMath Core."
The family review changes the materials specification from no listed multilingual supplement to inclusion of a Spanish-English glossary for the 22 identified students.
The executed award changes the funding record to the instructional-materials grant and the exact amount of $6,800.
